name: Lellish
description: The Lellish were the native sentient species of the planet Alk'Lellish III in the Expansion Region. Many Lellish became advertising professionals, a business in which they earned a sizable profit by promoting the hunting of a native predator known as the ketrann to offworld public servants. Wilek Nereus, later to become governor of Bakura, had dealings with the Lellish during a successful ketrann hunt.
